name: Pullman Jakarta Indonesia Thamrin CBD
short_description: A 427-room hotel on Jalan MH Thamrin near the HI Roundabout, spread across a 1972 Main Tower and a 2003 Pullman Tower, close to Grand Indonesia and Plaza Indonesia.
ai_summary: Pullman Jakarta Indonesia Thamrin CBD sits on Jalan M.H. Thamrin near the HI Roundabout in Central Jakarta, moments from Grand Indonesia and Plaza Indonesia shopping malls. The 427 rooms span two buildings -- the original 1972 Main Tower and the 2003 Pullman Tower extension -- with rooms in the newer wing generally rated more favorably than the original tower. Guests consistently describe the hotel as elegant with attentive, professional staff, praising the four dining venues (including Japanese dining at Kahyangan and pastries at Makaron) and central Thamrin location, while noting the Main Tower's older rooms show their age compared with the Pullman Tower.

pros: 427 rooms on Jalan MH Thamrin, moments from Grand Indonesia and Plaza Indonesia
Four distinct dining venues: Sana Sini (international), Kahyangan (Japanese), Makaron (pastries), and The Back Room (cocktails)
Rooms in the newer 2003 Pullman Tower are generally rated well above the original 1972 Main Tower
Staff consistently described as elegant, attentive, and professional
19 meeting rooms and a spa suit business travelers and events
cons: Rooms in the original 1972 Main Tower show more age than the 2003 Pullman Tower extension
As a large, two-building property, the layout can feel less intimate than boutique Thamrin alternatives
research_highlights: Staff professionalism and the hotel's elegant atmosphere draw consistent praise
The Thamrin/HI Roundabout location near Grand Indonesia and Plaza Indonesia is repeatedly called a strength
Guests recommend requesting a Pullman Tower room over the older Main Tower where possible
research_watchouts: The original Main Tower's rooms are dated relative to the newer Pullman Tower -- worth requesting the newer wing at booking

faqs.question: Does Pullman Jakarta Indonesia have more than one building?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the hotel's 427 rooms span two buildings: the original Main Tower from 1972 and the Pullman Tower added in 2003. Guests generally rate rooms in the newer Pullman Tower more favorably, so it's worth requesting that wing at booking.

faqs.question: Is Pullman Jakarta Indonesia close to Grand Indonesia mall?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it sits on Jalan MH Thamrin near the HI Roundabout, moments from both Grand Indonesia and Plaza Indonesia shopping malls, in the heart of Central Jakarta's business and leisure district.
